svg.title: ApexSDK: developer kits from ApexAi
svg.desc: ApexSDK: SDKs and agent plugins for Scrawl and DevOps. Each kit belongs to one product and talks only to that product. All four are open source on GitHub under the Apache License 2.0, and none is on a package registry or in an official plugin directory yet. Each works only with its product as an ApexAi-operated service, which is not offered publicly yet.
